title: Ep 17 · From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency: The 6 Shots on Goal & Physical Shunt Receipts
subtitle: Cecily, Marcus, and Devon audit the Spellcheck Goal, the 81.86x KV260 sub-bit FP32 decompression trap vs. 187.49 µJ packed integer WHT+XNOR, waiOS cross-ISA determinism, and the 25 Nov 2026 outside-review guardrails
summary: Cecily, Marcus, and Devon examine OpenIE's 6-shot experimental handoff (openIE-dev/openie-research-experiments @ 813eb96): why intelligence is a hindsight label on reliable low-energy agency (the Spellcheck Goal); why unpacking 52.72x compressed 0.1517 bpw weights (4,972 B) back to FP32 burns 81.86x MORE gross (71.91x net) physical measured_j on AMD Kria KV260 (TI INA260 5V SOM shunt, 63,335.56 µJ vs. 773.74 µJ INT8) and 19.08x more on Jetson AGX Thor (TI INA3221), whereas packed integer FWHT+XNOR+popcount+4-bit LUT drops to 187.49 µJ gross (10.30 µJ net, 4.13x–5.15x below INT8) on KV260, 104.44 µJ (7.95x below INT8) on Thor, and 1.49 µJ (0.11 µJ net, 96.33%) in a 4 KiB Null LUT; how waiOS (a541323b...) holds 0/400 drift across ARMv9, Cortex-A53, Raptor Lake, and Zen 5 with row-77 tamper halt (4ac7c4fb...) and cuts end-to-end 4-Stage Cascade KV260 measured_j by 26.58x gross (24.49x net), Thor by 16.26x, and Stage-4 calls by 38.46x; and why every table carries Signed Provenance · Self-Checked, measured_j ⊥ reported_j ⊥ est_j ⊥ unmetered, and Falsifier 6 idle-drift bounds.

turns.speaker: Cecily
turns.role: Lead Science Host · African American English
turns.text: Welcome to Episode Seventeen of OpenIE Research Radio! I'm Cecily, with skeptic Marcus and hardware lead Devon — three AI-synthesized personas voiced via ElevenLabs eleven_v4 and grounded in commit 813eb96: From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: First, our November twenty-fifth outside-review guardrails! Every table in 813eb96 carries Signed Provenance, Self-Checked — one-command Apache-2.0 kits are public, while external peer replication is still ahead. And measured_j, reported_j, est_j, and unmetered stay strictly orthogonal — never summed!

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.role: Systems & Compiler Architect · African American English
turns.text: Right! Intelligence is a hindsight label on reliable, low-energy agency. Nobody wakes a frontier model for English spellcheck! That's the Spellcheck Goal and our four-stage cascade: Lookup, Retrieve, local Integer or Solver, and Frontier last resort.

turns.speaker: Cecily
turns.role: Lead Science Host · African American English
turns.text: Walk us into Shots Two and Six, Devon — where physical DC shunts exposed the Decompression Impedance Tax!

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.role: Systems & Compiler Architect · African American English
turns.text: We compressed a 512 by 512 matrix 52.72 times to 0.1517 bits per weight — 4,972 bytes. Yet unpacking to FP32 at runtime on AMD Kria KV260's TI INA260 5V SOM shunt burned 63,335.56 µJ gross — 81.86 times MORE gross measured_j, and 71.91 times more net-above-idle, than 773.74 µJ INT8! On Jetson AGX Thor's TI INA3221 VDD_CPU_SOC_MSS shunt, FP32 unpacking burned 19.08 times more than INT8.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: Tiny bytes, 81.86 times worse energy! How did matching the operator fix it?

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.role: Systems & Compiler Architect · African American English
turns.text: Skip FP32! Packed integer FWHT plus XNOR, popcount, and a 4-bit LUT cut KV260 measured_j to 187.49 µJ gross and 10.30 µJ net — 4.13 to 5.15 times below INT8 — and cut Thor to 104.44 µJ, 7.95 times below INT8! Ahead of both, a 4 KiB Deterministic Null LUT resolves 96.33 percent at 1.49 µJ gross, 0.11 µJ net.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: And notice Falsifier Six in action: dedicated KV260 held 0.09 to 0.11 percent idle drift — inside our 5 percent gate, licensing A1 and A2 net subtraction — whereas shared-host Jetson Thor exceeded 5 percent drift, so single-window net subtraction was strictly withheld!

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.role: Systems & Compiler Architect · African American English
turns.text: Exactly! Then Shots Three, Five, and Six lock the whole cascade inside waiOS state digest a541323b: bit-exact across ARMv9, Cortex-A53, Raptor Lake, and Zen 5 with 0 of 400 schedule disagreements — Clopper–Pearson bound 0.00746 — plus row-77 tamper halt 4ac7c4fb! End to end, the cascade cuts KV260 measured_j 26.58 times gross and 24.49 times net, cuts Thor INA3221 16.26 times, and avoids 38.46 times of Stage-Four calls.

turns.speaker: Cecily
turns.role: Lead Science Host · African American English
turns.text: Dial those live hardware curves and grab the one-command Apache-2.0 kits at research.openie.dev/living/compiled-agency and blog.openie.dev — and inspect Episode Seventeen's signed WAI1 envelope right alongside this broadcast!
